name: Mesh2Motion Human Male
author: Quaternius
licenseEvidence: The archive's src/lib/RigModelVariations.ts identifies the male model as Quaternius, CC0. LICENSE-CC0.MD covers models, rigs and animations.
skeleton: 66 authored joints, including clavicles, spine, neck, head, arms, wrists, five articulated fingers per hand, thighs, calves, ankles and toes.
modifications: Source GLB copied unchanged; original anatomical proportions and skin weights retained.
Runtime rigid joint retargeting fits vehicle grips, seat and footrests without anisotropic bone scaling.
Finger joints curl around the controls; hands and feet have independent wrist and ankle orientation.
Runtime vertex colors and procedural fabric UVs provide an orange jersey, charcoal-blue trousers, gloves and boots without changing the authored geometry.
Motocross protective gear and helmet are separate meshes attached to physical limb proxies.
